name: Natsu no Majo no Parade
source:
In a slightly different world, girls called ‘witches’ who are born with a rare mysterious ability are required to use their powers to help people. Living in the rural village of Kanahara-mura, Yukito is the son of the great witch Yuris. However, he has no magic ability whatsoever and lives a normal life like any other young boy. He thought his days would continue like this, until three witches-in-training appeared before him. The girls, Arisa, Carol and Topia, came to complete their graduation training “Witches’ Parade” in order to become a full-fledged witch. They ended up freeloading at his house, and he was asked to watch over them. He couldn’t just leave these eccentric girls who are new to the area alone, so he agreed to the request. However, that wasn’t the end of his suffering.

On that first night together, Arisa and Carol both proclaimed that he was their fiancé. He didn’t remember having ever made such a promise, but when he asked Yuris, she told him that he had promised to marry them when they became a witch. He couldn’t back out from a witch’s promise, so he must choose one of them before they complete their training, that is unless he already has a girlfriend. With his senpai Azuki aggressively going after him and his bracon imouto Saya returning from witch’s school, he senses that this will be the most boisterous summer of his life.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/09/27/september-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
在一个略有不同的世界，天生拥有罕见神秘能力、被称为“魔女”的女孩必须使用力量帮助他人。雪人生活在乡下的金原村，是伟大魔女尤莉丝的儿子。然而，他完全没有魔法能力，像普通男孩一样过着平凡生活。他以为日子会一直这样下去，直到三名魔女实习生出现在面前。爱莉莎、卡萝和托皮亚来到这里，是为了完成成为正式魔女所需的毕业修行“魔女游行”。她们最后寄住在雪人家，还请他照顾自己。面对刚到当地、又如此古怪的女孩，他无法置之不理，只能答应请求。然而，烦恼才刚刚开始。

共同生活的第一晚，爱莉莎和卡萝都宣布雪人是自己的未婚夫。他完全不记得做过这种承诺，询问尤莉丝后才知道，自己曾答应等她们成为魔女后与她们结婚。魔女的约定不能反悔，因此除非他已经有女友，否则必须在她们完成修行前选出一人。与此同时，学姐梓积极追求他，患有兄控情结的妹妹沙耶也从魔女学校归来。雪人感觉这会是自己一生中最喧闹的夏天。

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/09/27/september-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
